name: com.tapjoy.TJWebViewActivity
description: The Tapjoy Android SDK opens an in-app full-screen browser for web pages or HTML supplied by Tapjoy ad content. The Tapjoy mediation adapter starts it when that content requests a full-screen web page.
disableEffect: Tapjoy ad pages that use this screen will not open, and rewards for watching ads shown through it will no longer be granted.
